name: @art-pollinator/node
description: Composition root for the stationary-node target (SPEC.md §4, issue #45): a long-lived Node process wiring HttpTransportServer + LanDiscoveryResponder + SqliteMetadataRepository to the same app/core SwapService/LibraryService the mobile composition root uses — no domain logic duplicated between them. Depends on app, core, and adapters/*; never depended on by any of them.
